# Command reference

Every slash command in `src/commands/`. A command is a Markdown prompt body;
`$ARGUMENTS` receives the text typed after the command name. Commands without
an `agent:` key run in the TUI's current session.

| Command | Agent | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `config-check` | build | Audit AGENTS.md references and .ai/* files against the codebase |
| `debug-code` | build | Debug failures/bugs with root-cause fix loop |
| `devils-advocate` | (default) | Adversarial review of a proposal |
| `eli5` | (default) | Explain a concept from first principles |
| `git-status` | (default) | Explain what the pending git changes are trying to do |
| `humanize` | (default) | Rewrite text without corporate or AI markers |
| `init-project` | build | Create or update `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/*` files |
| `step-by-step` | (default) | Deconstruct a task into an idempotent sequential plan |
| `truthmode` | (default) | Strict empirical rigor and epistemic calibration |
